pr_title: GameEngine: close ADR 0121 first-release parity gaps
pr_body:
## Summary

Re-audits ADR 0121 on current main after #145 and closes the remaining first-release semantic parity gaps. Material and Project Settings live Editor mutations now create undoable history through the existing shared typed-document service, matching Animation Set. Regression coverage compares direct Editor semantics, registry-driven generic MCP, domain MCP tools, and CLI for Material, Project Settings, and Animation Set, including validation, preview/apply diffs, stale revision rejection, committed state, persistence, and Editor undo/redo.

## Compatibility

No persisted schema, Stable ID, capability ID, public tool name, ProjectRoot confinement rule, or MCP lifecycle contract changes. MCP remains Editor-attached and is not a competing file writer.

## Validation

Run Windows Validation in affected mode for the changed editor crate and its authoring/CLI/MCP dependency surface. Visual Validation is not required because no UI layout or appearance is changed.
